acceptanceCriteria: Batch-integrator procedure (skill or docs) requires one push after all merges and one push per CI failure round
A check or report counts cancelled runs per batch PR so the rate is visible
Measured over the next 10 batches: no more than 1 cancelled run per batch on average
body: Batch integrators pushed after each constituent merge or each fix, cancelling the prior run through concurrency groups. Counted 12 cancelled batch-PR runs on 2026-10-21, about 250 runner-minutes, on a host limited to about 2 concurrent CI runs. Interim mitigation: integrator charter 1021e requires merging all constituents and fixing preflight failures before a single push, and fixing all CI failures in one commit.
